@@ -0,0 +1,19 @@
+---
+import HomeCard from "@components/HomeCard.astro";
+
+import { getLangFromUrl, useTranslations } from "@i18n/utils";
+
+const asParam = Astro.url.searchParams.get("as")! || "";
+const isStudio = asParam === "studio";
+
+const lang = getLangFromUrl(Astro.url);
+const t = useTranslations(lang);
+---
+
+<section class="w-full m-auto p-1 md:w-10/12 md:p-0">
+  <form action="/contacts" method="get" data-astro-reload>
+    {isStudio && <input type="hidden" name="as" value="studio" />}
+    <input type="hidden" name="ref" value="schedule" />
+    <HomeCard title={t('home.scheduleSection.title')} description={t('home.scheduleSection.description')} buttonText="Marcar" />
+  </form>
+</section>
